# 

# MMLCA: an R package for the identification and characterization of multimorbidity patterns using latent class analysis

**MMLCA** aims to simplify the identification of multimorbidity patterns
through user-friendly functions. Leveraging the power of Latent Class
Analysis (LCA) as implemented in the `poLCA` package, **MMLCA** provides
an accessible and efficient tool for researchers.

## Installation

You can install the development version of MMLCA from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ARCbiostat/MMLCA")
```

## Tutorial

A paper tutorial will be soon out, stay tuned!

## Citation

To cite MMLCA in publications use:

Gregorio C., Luo H., Beridze G., Damiano C., Ornago A.M., Triolo F.,
Calderón-Larrañaga A., Vetrano D.L. (2026). MMLCA: an R package for the
identification and characterization of multimorbidity patterns using
latent class analysis. R package version: 2.0
<https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`assign_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/assign_LCA.md)
  [`assign_LCA()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/assign_LCA.md)
  : Assign subjects to the their most probable mm pattern according to
  LCA model
- [`datamm2`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/datamm2.md)
  : Multimorbidity Data 2
- [`fit_outcome_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/fit_outcome_mmlca.md)
  : Title
- [`get_accuracy()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/get_accuracy.md)
  : Function to get the accuracy from LCA object
- [`get_entropy()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/get_entropy.md)
  : Function to get the entropy from LCA object
- [`get_internal_validation_matrix()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/get_internal_validation_matrix.md)
  : Function to calculate the approximate misclassifications matrix
- [`ggOE()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggOE.md) :
  Plot Observed/Expected Ratios
- [`ggOEx()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggOEx.md) :
  Plot the Observed/Expected Ratios and Exclusivity
- [`ggOEx_adaptive()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggOExDyn.md)
  [`ggOExDyn()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggOExDyn.md)
  : Plot the Observed/Expected Ratios and Exclusivity
- [`ggaccuracy()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggaccuracy_LCA.md)
  [`ggaccuracy_LCA()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggaccuracy_LCA.md)
  : Accuracy of LCA derived Multimorbidity Patterns
- [`ggcompare_classes()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggcompare_classes.md)
  : Compare class assignments across latent class solutions
- [`ggentropy()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggentropy.md)
  : Obtain Entropy plot and train and test data
- [`ggprevalence()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggprev.md)
  [`ggprev()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggprev.md)
  : Plot disease prevalences within MM patterns
- [`ggprevalence_spaghetti()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggprev_spaghetti.md)
  [`ggprev_spaghetti()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/ggprev_spaghetti.md)
  : Plot disease prevalences within MM patterns
- [`mmdata`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/mmdata.md) :
  Multimorbidity Data
- [`impute_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/multiple_imputation.md)
  [`multiple_imputation()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/multiple_imputation.md)
  : Function to obtain imputate multiple imputations of the assigned MM
  patterns
- [`prepare_data()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/prepare_data.md)
  : Prepare the chronic disease dataset for the LCA
- [`fit_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/run_LCA.md)
  [`run_LCA()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/run_LCA.md)
  : Main function to run the LCA
- [`select_conditions()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/select_conditions.md)
  : Identify chronic conditions above threshold prevalence
- [`select_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/select_number_LCA.md)
  [`select_number_LCA()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/select_number_LCA.md)
  : Function to run LCA with different number of classes and compare the
  goodness-of-fit
- [`stability_mmlca()`](https://github.com/ARCbiostat/MMLCA/reference/stability_mmlca.md)
  : Function to run LCA with different number of classes/resamples and
  compare the goodness-of-fit
